name: Comprehensiveness
description: This metric measures how well the summary captures the main points of the article. A good summary should include all the important details and events mentioned in the article.
scale: Continuous (0-100%, where 100% means the summary includes all the main points)

name: Coherence
description: This metric evaluates the logical flow and connectivity of ideas within the summary. A coherent summary should present the main points in a clear and organized manner, enabling readers to easily understand the content.
scale: Continuous (0-100%, where 100% means the summary is highly coherent)

name: Fluency
description: This metric assesses the grammatical correctness and readability of the summary. A fluent summary should have proper syntax, punctuation, and word usage, making it easy to read and comprehend.
scale: Continuous (0-100%, where 100% means the summary is highly fluent)

name: Relevance
description: This metric measures the extent to which the summary focuses on the most important information in the article. A relevant summary should prioritize the main points and events, while omitting minor or insignificant details.
scale: Continuous (0-100%, where 100% means the summary is highly relevant)

name: Conciseness
description: This metric evaluates the summary's ability to convey the main points of the article in a succinct and brief manner. A concise summary should avoid redundancy and verbosity, making it easier for readers to quickly grasp the key information.
scale: Continuous (0-100%, where 100% means the summary is highly concise)

name: ROUGE
description: Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE) is a metric that measures the similarity between the generated summary and a set of reference summaries. ROUGE compares the n-gram overlap between the generated and reference summaries to assess the summary's quality.
scale: Continuous (0-1, where 1 means the generated summary is identical to the reference summary)

name: BLEU
description: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) is a metric that measures the similarity between the generated summary and a set of reference summaries. BLEU compares the n-gram precision between the generated and reference summaries to evaluate the summary's quality.
scale: Continuous (0-1, where 1 means the generated summary is identical to the reference summary)

name: METEOR
description: Metric for Evaluation of Translation with Explicit ORdering (METEOR) is a metric that measures the similarity between the generated summary and a set of reference summaries. METEOR uses a combination of unigram precision, recall, and alignment to evaluate the summary's quality.
scale: Continuous (0-1, where 1 means the generated summary is identical to the reference summary)
